name: Milind Patel
title: Senior Full-Stack Developer & Web Development Manager
summary: Senior full-stack developer and web development manager with 10+ years of experience (since 2015) designing, building, and maintaining complex, high-availability web systems — C# and ASP.NET Core back ends, Angular and React front ends, and Microsoft SQL Server — on Azure and AWS. Currently architects, maintains, and develops 8 applications (5 customer-facing, 3 internal) and 12 API integrations, including Google Maps location and address services and Bambora and Moneris payment tokenization. Runs containerized services on Kubernetes behind load balancers, with a focus on scalability, resilience, performance, and security. Has kept Rexall's applications PCI DSS compliant through 4 consecutive years of passed audits, builds Claude-powered AI agents for complex engineering work, and leads a blended team of 3 in-house and 2 vendor developers.

experience.title: Web Development Manager
bullets: Architect, maintain, and develop 8 applications (5 customer-facing, 3 internal) and 12 API integrations — with Angular and React on the front end, ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework on the back end, MS SQL Server, and Magento for e-commerce — authoring design documents and impact analyses for cross-application changes.

Built location and address features with the Google Maps JavaScript API (interactive maps in the browser) and the Geocoding API (converting addresses into latitude/longitude coordinates), caching geocoded coordinates within Google's 30-day caching limit to reduce API calls and cost.

Integrated the Bambora (now Worldline) and Moneris payment gateways with tokenization — card details are exchanged for gateway-issued tokens (Bambora payment profiles, Moneris Vault data keys) so card numbers are never stored on Rexall's servers, reducing PCI DSS scope.

Designed a resilient integration layer for internal and third-party APIs — an ASP.NET Core Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) API that centralizes calls and response transformation for the Angular and React front ends, with retry, timeout, and circuit-breaker policies.

Lead the incremental modernization of legacy ASP.NET Framework applications to ASP.NET Core, separating tightly coupled modules into independently deployable services and applying Dependency Injection, the Strategy pattern, and layered architecture to lower regression risk.

Run containerized ASP.NET Core services on Kubernetes behind load balancers — defining deployments, liveness and readiness probes, and Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules — and partner with the networking team on DNS, SSL/TLS, and firewall rules.
Troubleshoot complex production issues spanning the application, database, and network layers using Azure Application Insights and log analysis, driving root-cause fixes.

Own PCI DSS compliance across the Magento, .NET, and React applications — remediating vulnerability-scan findings (OWASP Top 10), hardening code and configuration, and compiling audit evidence — continuing a 4-year record of passed PCI audits through the move from PCI DSS v3.2.1 to v4.0.

Design Claude-powered AI agents for complex, multi-step engineering work — cross-application impact analysis, legacy-code refactoring, test generation, and audit-evidence preparation — and author team guidance on prompt engineering.
Lead a blended team of 3 in-house and 2 vendor developers — running architecture and design reviews, PR reviews, and sprint planning with Product, and joining vendor and security assessments.

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Developed and maintained full-stack features across Rexall's applications — Angular 12 and React 18 front ends over ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework back ends — building RESTful APIs, reusable UI components, and third-party integrations including Google Maps and payment gateways.
Resolved database and application bottlenecks by rewriting complex T-SQL stored procedures, adding indexes, and analyzing execution plans, speeding up page loads and long-running reports.
Remediated PCI DSS audit and vulnerability-scan findings across the Magento sites, ASP.NET C# applications, and React applications, and gathered audit evidence, with every annual audit passed.
Owned code merges, code drops, and patches across multiple ASP.NET C# applications, and built and maintained Azure DevOps build and release pipelines for consistent, repeatable deployments.
Provisioned and configured Azure and AWS components for a security-confidential cloud environment alongside the operations and networking teams.
Troubleshot time-critical production incidents across UI, API, and database layers, restoring service and fixing root causes; reviewed pull requests and supported developers on technical problems.

experience.title: .NET Developer
bullets: Designed and developed full-stack web applications with Angular 11 and .NET 5 Web APIs, working within an Agile team across every phase of the SDLC.

Built an event-driven integration on RabbitMQ — message consumers plus scheduled SQL jobs that process queued events and generate downstream data — decoupling upstream systems from reporting workloads.
Implemented system-wide audit logging with SQL triggers and stored procedures that capture before/after record changes for traceability and support.
Upgraded and extended Telerik Kendo UI for Angular components to speed up UI development, letting the team focus on value-generating features.
Set up and configured Microsoft Azure cloud components for development, test, and production environments.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Partnered with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to translate user stories into automated process flows built on the DST AWD (Automated Work Distributor) BPM platform.
Built rule-driven document-filtering automation using XML logic and ASG Mobius Document Direct, removing manual document-handling steps.
Built user interfaces for custom internal applications on an ASP.NET C# back end.
Wrote parameterized stored procedures powering reporting and data retrieval across SQL Server and Oracle.
Built reusable SSIS ETL packages to ingest flat-file, Excel, and XML sources into SQL Server, plus DTS import/export routines delivering SQL Server data to client-side destinations.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Built Angular front ends backed by ASP.NET Core Web APIs for internal business-process applications.
Designed and automated business processes in IBM Business Process Manager (BPM) 8.5 — developing Business Process Definitions (BPDs) from requirements and deploying them to test environments.
Captured data requirements with business analysts through process blueprints and Visio diagrams.
Validated BPDs with positive and negative test cases, comparing expected and actual results through manual and automated testing.

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
bullets: Architected and built a multi-module School ERP platform on ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, Angular, and SQL Server that automated school back-office workflows and streamlined resource planning.
Designed RESTful APIs, normalized SQL Server schemas, and stored procedures, and built responsive Bootstrap UIs across the application.
Worked directly with clients to turn business requirements into scalable solutions, owning scope definition, estimation, planning, and tracking for API and application development.
Mentored junior developers through code reviews and pairing, establishing coding standards across design, coding, testing, and debugging.
